qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Dominant franchise in Swiss occupational pensions (BVG Pillar 2) and proprietary IFA distribution networks in Germany/France, supplemented by Swiss Life Asset Managers (leading European real estate asset manager). Sticky multi-year corporate client relationships and disciplined underwriting deliver 12-16% ROE.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 5, REJECT). Long-term runway is constrained by European demographic aging, regulatory caps on Swiss pension conversion rates (BVG), and commercial real estate exposure in its asset management division, preventing a 15+ year durable competitive advantage period.
qualitative.evidence: Solid 12-16% ROE and strong fee generation from Swiss Life Asset Managers (CHF 875M fee result in FY24). However, as a life and pension insurer, it faces acute secular demographic headwinds (aging European population, Pillar 2 statutory conversion rate reductions) and cyclical sensitivity in real estate fund management, capping CAP well below the 15-year hurdle.
